audit_role: Independent read-only inheritance/source audit by a collaborating research agent; creates this new receipt only
method: Compare actual raw file bytes to starting Git blob content using SHA1(blob header+bytes); inspect CRLF-to-LF-only differences separately. No array parsing, solver application, test rerun, CI execution or native/quasar pixel access. Frozen physical files also compared directly to first-freeze bytes and SHA256.

inherited_document_line_ending_exception.explanation: These two README.md working-tree files contain CRLF while the starting commit blobs contain LF. Replacing CRLF with LF in memory reproduces the exact original Git blob. Git reports no change. This audit has no saved raw-working-tree snapshot from the starting time and does not claim to date the checkout conversion. No numerical data or source equation differs.
